name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight & Signal Heist Puzzles
promotionalText: Three free offline modes. Fly twelve 3D worlds, unlock crystal gates and restore city lights through Signal Heist. Created by Mcaulee Maddison at MacWebStudio.
description:
SkyPulse Arcade, by Mcaulee Maddison at MacWebStudio (macwebstudio.com), brings mechanical-bird flight and signal-routing puzzles together in three free offline modes.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, clear pipe openings and collect crystals. Travel through twelve 3D worlds, changing every 15 gates before the route repeats. Connected island districts feature cliff galleries, supported terraces, recessed windows and themed lighting. Each world has matching pipes with animated LED inlays. Mechanical birds bank, beat their wings on taps and leave engine trails.

Seven pickups include shielding, time slowing, crystal attraction, bonus crystals and route guides. Supply Cache grants five crystals; Gate Link rewards the next three clean gate passes. Earn bird-specific Ion, Prism and Aurora display-cradle lighting through flight milestones.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect both randomly placed crystals for each numbered gate. The first charges half the ring; at 2/2 its red lasers turn blue and the gate unlocks automatically. Fly through the hollow 3D hoop, avoid the runway and reach the exit. Choose Next Mission after a clear. Circuits refresh each UTC day and remain consistent across restarts.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Restore eight systems through eight increasingly demanding Signal Heist vaults. Tap prisms to rotate mirrors and route live energy on a raised 3D console. Power every core and the uplink together. Splitters divide beams; powered relays open matching shutters. Each turn costs 1 trace, or 3 with a lit red sensor. PLAN previews the next rotation, beam path and exact cost for free.

Each cleared vault saves its medal, restores a named lighting network in all twelve flight worlds and activates the next puzzle immediately. An interrupted daily extraction save offers Retry Save while the app retains the solved route. Four optional authored daily heist designs rotate by UTC day; saved attempts resume. Gold on all four earns Archivist cradle lighting.

BUILD YOUR FLOCK
Unlock 15 founder birds with distinct Endless reward traits. Train up to level 5 within your Core's limit. Each completed training level adds 2% off future founder-bird unlocks, up to 20%, alongside stronger reward traits. Preview the next unlock's exact saving before spending.

At Core level 2, choose two owned parents and preview inherited traits and the breeding cost. Both parents stay; a permanent offspring joins your Hangar. Level 3+ parents can pass stronger grades within the Core's limit. Duplicate owned combinations cannot charge again. All birds share flight handling and collision rules. Reward traits apply to Endless; Relay bird selection is cosmetic.

CORE & TECH
Evolve the SkyPulse Core through Ion, Jade, Prism, Solar and Nova. Higher levels raise training limits and lineage capacity. Levels 2–5 reduce Tech Tree, training and breeding prices by 5%, 10%, 15% and 20%. Core evolution has its own cost.

Pan through the connected holographic Tech Tree. Twelve upgrade families each have three levels. Inspect the exact effect and final price before purchasing. The run report separates bird rewards from Tech bonuses.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Complete four tasks and claim five crystals each, up to 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. The reset time appears in your local time zone.

Home starts on Endless Route. Tap the top-left badge to change modes. HOW TO PLAY covers flight, puzzles, worlds, pickups, Tech, Core evolution, training and breeding.

Portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with pause, retry, Main Menu, Reduced Motion, sound and haptic settings. No advertising, account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.
